data.pr_title: Refactor retry backoff and webhook signature verification

data.title: Empty signature header bypasses HMAC check when secret is rotating
data.explanation: verify_signature returns True when x_signature is an empty string during key rotation window due to truthiness check on fallback secret.
data.intended_behavior: Empty or malformed signatures must always be rejected with False.

data.title: Legacy v1 timestamp parser fails on leap-second ISO strings
data.explanation: parse_legacy_timestamp raises ValueError on :60 leap second timestamps.

data.reasoning: Webhook endpoints sit behind an API gateway that strips requests without headers, so empty signature strings should not happen in production.
data.quoted_intent: Support dual-secret rotation for zero-downtime webhook key rollovers.

rebuttal_rulings.reason: The quoted intent merely mentions dual-secret rotation and never authorizes accepting empty HMAC signatures; relying on upstream gateway filtering is not documented spec.

data.ruling: Charge C2 was flagged as a pre-existing issue on BASE and dropped from this PR's liability. However, Charge C1 proves a high-severity authentication bypass on empty HMAC signatures introduced by this PR. The Defender's rebuttal is overruled and the PR is blocked.
data.summary: High-severity HMAC bypass proven by sandbox execution; Defender rebuttal overruled; PR blocked.
